title: Clerk agent command
description: A copyable one-line prompt for coding agents. Tab style: a dark folder tab with an S-curved edge (a stack of small round marks and a label) sitting on a pale, softly shadowed mono command bar with a copy button. Pill style: a compact grey pill with the marks, the label and a copy icon.
notes: copies to the clipboard and swaps the icon for a tick, so it needs JavaScript
